environment.inference: real CPU ONNX Runtime detection and segmentation; mock camera SDK for camera integration

builds.note: Suite counts overlap; these are not a claim of 50 distinct tests. Horizon helper code was compiled against x86 vendor libraries; actual X5 BIN inference was not run.

same_data_regression.purpose: Behavior-preserving structural refactor check; not Stereo accuracy or X5 performance validation.

limitations: det and seg are independent engine instances but retain legacy global-state serialization; no FPS improvement claim.
One algorithm instance per type; fixed supported input bindings; no arbitrary graph port rewiring or independent per-model cadence.
Online Stereo still uses same-frame pair registration around the legacy left-only disparity callback.
Full SDK entry retains a process-global gate across sessions.
Real camera, X5 model output, BPU SDK compatibility and board CPU/RSS/FPS remain unverified in this environment.
No CPU Stereo ONNX backend was added.
